# Project Overview

A demonstration project using next.js (v14) with OpenTelemetry and Azure Application Insights.

## Scenario

A user can enter thier zip code to get the current weather for the provided zip code.

The app uses Open Weather API to get the weather.

## Key Technologies

- next.js (v14) with App Router
- ShadCN
- Tailwind
- Open Telemetry using @vercel/otel
- Azure Application Insights
